Frequently asked questions

Is there a long-term contract?

Not on monthly plans: cancel any time and access continues to the end of the paid month. Annual plans are billed once and are non-refundable if you cancel early.

How fast does it go live?

Your site is built before you see it. After you pay, it goes live in about a minute, with your dashboard login in your email.

Who makes changes after launch?

You do, in your dashboard, within your plan. Micro edits text, contact info and images; SMB adds more control. We do not write custom code for individual customers.

What about my domain?

Your site is available at a BuildFlow subdomain right away. You can point your own domain at it; the domain stays yours.

Do you guarantee leads?

No. We build and maintain a fast, accessible site with click-to-call and forms. Lead volume depends on your market and search engines.

What does Offboard mean?

You pay once, take the site and the domain, and host it yourself. There is no ongoing support; we give you documentation and videos.

Is the site available in Spanish?

Not at launch. English first; Spanish is planned.

Want to see your site?

Ask for your demo and we'll show you your site and your dashboard.
